title: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy

At Travelluxx, accessible from https://travelluxx.co.uk, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by Travelluxx and how we use it.

Information We Collect

When you book a private hire or transfer with us, we collect your name, phone number, email address, pickup and dropoff locations to deliver executive transport services.
metaDescription: Read Travelluxx privacy policy and data collection terms.

faqs.question: What personal information does TravelLuxx collect when booking?
faqs.answer: We only collect essential passenger information required to complete your booking, including your name, contact phone number, email address, and pickup/destination addresses.

faqs.question: How is payment and credit card information secured?
faqs.answer: All payments are processed securely through PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways (such as Mollie). TravelLuxx does not store full credit or debit card numbers on our servers.

faqs.question: Is my journey history shared with any third parties?
faqs.answer: No. TravelLuxx maintains strict confidentiality and never sells or discloses your travel history or personal details to third parties for marketing purposes.

title: Terms & Conditions
content:
Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Travelluxx. By accessing or using our chauffeur booking services, you agree to be bound by these terms.

Bookings & Cancellations

All bookings must be confirmed in advance. Cancellations made 24 hours prior to travel receive full refund.
metaDescription: Terms and conditions for Travelluxx executive chauffeur bookings.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and amendment policy?
faqs.answer: Bookings may be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 12 hours prior to your scheduled pickup time. Cancellations made inside 12 hours may be subject to a cancellation fee.

faqs.question: How does complimentary airport waiting time work?
faqs.answer: All airport pickups include 60 minutes of complimentary waiting time from the moment the aircraft touches down. Additional waiting time is charged at standard hourly rates.

faqs.question: Are luggage and personal belongings insured during the transfer?
faqs.answer: Passengers luggage is transported under our comprehensive operator insurance policy. We ask all passengers to ensure delicate items are safely packed.
